title: Fundamental theorem of calculus along a ray: ∫_0^∞ Da(y − rθ)θ dr = a(y) (Step 4(a))
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let a : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = Eucl n) be C¹ with compact support, and let y, θ ∈ ℝⁿ with θ ≠ 0. Then ∫_{(0,∞)} Da(y − rθ)θ dr = a(y).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : Eucl n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 a → HasCompactSupport a → ∀ y θ : Eucl n, θ ≠ 0 → ∫ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ), fderiv ℝ a (y - r • θ) θ = a y
